name: IntegrateIT Lutron RadioRA Classic
notes: Drives a legacy Lutron RadioRA Classic (RadioRA 1) system through its RS232 Interface or Chronos System Bridge: dimmer levels, switch on/off, GRAFIK Eye scenes, phantom button presses including ALL ON / ALL OFF, and live two-way feedback parsing (zone changes, zone map, LED map, master control presses) into per-zone variables and events.
